scope: Targeted primary-source audit; not an exhaustive literature review. Own variational identities and conditional lemmas are derived in renormalization_map.md.

sources.title: The renormalized locally covariant Dirac field
sources.relevance: Current conservation and its ambiguity; restricted nonperturbative stress argument.
sources.scope_limit: Does not supply our strong-F current-and-directional-stress closure.

sources.title: Conservation of the stress tensor in perturbative interacting quantum field theory in curved spacetimes
sources.relevance: Perturbative scalar construction of compatible conservation conditions.
sources.scope_limit: Not a charged Dirac Bianchi-I existence theorem.

sources.inspection: Primary research; abstract and equation-index search inspection

sources.relevance: RG consistency and gauge constraints at a momentum cutoff; one-loop beta coefficient.
sources.scope_limit: Not regulator independence of our finite-mode current/stress.

sources.title: Electric charge renormalization to all orders
sources.scope_limit: No new numerical charge measurement in this project.

sources.title: Running couplings from adiabatic regularization
sources.inspection: Primary research; sections I–V targeted inspection

sources.title: Fine-structure constant: Is it really a constant?

sources.title: Inflationary Universe with Anisotropic Hair
